acceptanceCriteria: Archived evidence remains valid after a post-archive repository commit and close succeeds with structured human decision
Tampered archive, evidence identity, manifest digest, and foreign runtime still fail closed
Large tracked text files remain inspectable from bounded patch facts when the patch itself is within the inspection limit
Regression tests and tri-language lifecycle documentation describe immutable archive binding
goal: Allow close to validate immutable archived evidence against its archive manifest after repository HEAD changes, while preserving fail-closed tamper and identity checks
intent: Fix archived Work Item close after merge without weakening evidence integrity
